 "data": "erDiagram
 ACCOUNT {
 uuid account_id PK
 bigint version
 varchar(3) currency_code
 varchar(10) account_status
 decimal(19_2) available_balance
 decimal(19_2) reserved_balance
 timestamptz created_at
 timestamptz updated_at
 }

 AUTHORISATION {
 uuid authorisation_id PK
 bigint version
 uuid account_id FK
 varchar(128) merchant_reference
 decimal(19_2) amount
 varchar(3) currency_code
 varchar(10) authorisation_status
 timestamptz created_at
 timestamptz updated_at
 }

 AUTHORISATION_EVENT {
 uuid event_id PK
 uuid authorisation_id FK
 uuid account_id FK
 varchar(40) event_type
 varchar(30) idempotency_key
 decimal(19_2) amount
 varchar(3) currency_code
 varchar(30) reason_code
 uuid correlation_id
 timestamptz created_at
 }

 OUTBOX_EVENT {
 uuid event_id PK
 bigint version
 varchar(20) aggregate_type
 uuid aggregate_id
 varchar(30) event_type
 jsonb payload
 varchar(30) status
 int retry_count
 varchar(100) last_error
 timestamptz created_at
 timestamptz published_at
 timestamptz next_attempt_at
 varchar(30) idempotency_key
 uuid correlation_id
 varchar(55) trace_parent
 timestamptz claimed_at
 timestamptz claim_until
 }

 ACCOUNT ||--o{ AUTHORISATION: owns
 ACCOUNT ||--o{ AUTHORISATION_EVENT: emits
 AUTHORISATION ||--o{ AUTHORISATION_EVENT: has
 AUTHORISATION ||--o{ OUTBOX_EVENT: aggregate_id_logical
